question: If 18% of first number is equal to two-fifths of second number, what is the ratio of first number to the second number?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the given fraction into a percentage directly to easily compare.

2 / 5 = (2 / 5) × 100% = 40%

Now, we have 18% of First Number = 40% of Second Number.

If a% of A = b% of B, then the ratio A : B is simply b : a.

First Number : Second Number = 40 : 18 = 20 : 9

**∴ The correct answer is 20 : 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

18% of First Number = 2/5 of Second Number

 
 18% of First Number
 =
 
 2/5 of Second Number
 
• 
 
• 
 First : Second = (2/5) : 18% = 40 : 18 = 20 : 9

**Calculations:**

Let the first number be x and the second number be y.

⇒ 18% of x = (2 / 5) of y

⇒ (18 / 100) × x = (2 / 5) × y

Cross-multiplying to simplify the equation:

⇒ 18 × 5 × x = 2 × 100 × y

⇒ 90x = 200y

⇒ x / y = 200 / 90

⇒ x / y = 20 / 9

⇒ x : y = 20 : 9

**∴ The correct answer is 20 : 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

To easily convert any fraction into a percentage, multiply it by 100. For example, 2/5 = (2/5) × 100% = 40%.

Equating Quantities Shortcut

If you are given that p% of A = q% of B, the ratio of A to B is always in the inverse proportion of their percentages, which means A : B = q : p.

Proportion Fundamentals

When two ratios are set equal to each other, it is called a proportion. In A / B = C / D, A × D = B × C always holds true due to cross-multiplication.
